tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
UK firms say they need a 12-month compact to ease public opposition to datacentres, confirmed by The Guardian, before construction faces threats.
What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble? Confirmed per BBC: artificial intelligence found severe PHP flaws, triggering global website shutdowns and urgent patching.
Websites globally went dark as operators addressed an artificial intelligence detected flaw in a web programming language, confirmed by East Bay Times.
OpenAI's artificial intelligence found a critical PHP vulnerability, reported by BigGo Finance, with one billion dollars pledged to help defenders respond.
Cloudflare links the vulnerability discovery to defense efforts with OpenAI, reported by OpenAI in their latest statement on the crisis response.
Free every hour.
